text:
Ana (Product): dropped a micro-mock for a compact p95 + heatmap card. quick ask: decide hover layout, scrubber keyboard behavior, and where sampling controls live. link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE

Rohan (Design): two patterns: (1) slim right flyout that stays out of the timeline, (2) anchored bottom popover for narrow screens. flyout keeps context; popover is easier for touch.

Bea (Frontend): agree on flyout desktop / popover mobile. implement keyboard focus move into the flyout on open, Esc returns focus. ensure aria roles: `role=dialog` but aria-modal=false.

Marcus (Infra): backend can add `sample_count` per bucket; showing n helps users see confidence. we'll emit bucket timestamps so scrubber can snap precisely.

Sam (PM): microcopy preference: "p95: 295 ms · n=2,100". short and consistent. add a tiny "Drill into traces" link.

a11y-bot: checklist: scrubber >=44px target, `aria-valuenow` and `aria-valuetext` present, Left/Right move scrubber, focus-visible clearly styled, popover announced via `role=status` or `aria-live`.

Rohan (Design): heatmap color: use Viridis ramp, legend text: "darker = more requests". for mobile show 3 buckets, desktop 5.

Bea (Frontend): sampling: per-card override with org default fallback. hide advanced setting in gear menu and show current state in tooltip. lazy-load flyout details after first open to keep initial page light.

Marcus (Infra): note: adaptive scrubber step size based on visible timeframe is doable; client can snap to nearest bucket timestamp we serve.

Rohan (Design): accessibility nit: ensure hover and focus show identical content. visible focus ring should be 3px and use high-contrast color.

Ana (Product): decisions: flyout desktop, popover mobile, per-card sampling under gear with org default, viridis palette, short microcopy, show n samples. Rohan to update Figma, Bea/Marcus to prototype keyboard + lazy-load, Sam to update docs.

Bea (Frontend): will prototype and post link. will debounce scrubber keyboard moves to avoid noisy backend calls.

Rohan (Design): updated Figma (v3) and left a11y items in comments.

Ana (Product): thanks all 97 closing thread and consolidating notes into the spec.
